newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Petrochemical in bank deal.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petrochemical in bank deal.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) and Shanghai Petrochemical Co have signed an agreement to form a cooperative relationship, Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Under the pact, the bank will provide the firm with 700 million yuan in loans this year to be used for a renovation project, it said.

The ICBC branch has also agreed to assist the firm's restructuring of its financial management by using the bank's knowledge in capital management, clearance networking and computer applications, it said.
Since 1994, the bank has lent 4.5 billion yuan to the petrochemical firm.
